messages.text: Hi, I'm in office for the first time and can't figure out the WiFi. Which network do I join?
Welcome! Connect to 'Corp-Secure' with your SSO credentials. Do not use 'Corp-Guest' — that network is throttled and blocks internal resources.
When I try Corp-Secure it asks for a domain. What should I enter?
Leave the domain field blank. Use your full email for the identity field. The certificate prompt is expected — accept it.
I need a JetBrains license for my onboarding setup. The software portal says I'm not authorized.
Your manager needs to approve the license first. I can see the request was submitted but the approval is pending. Let me ping them.
Actually, I see the issue — your account was created under the wrong cost center. I've escalated to IT provisioning. Should be fixed within 2 hours.
Is there a temporary license I can use in the meantime?
Yes — you can use a 30-day trial directly from JetBrains with your corporate email. The license will be merged when provisioning is fixed.
The benefits portal shows an error when I try to enroll. My start date was Monday. Is there a waiting period?
No waiting period but sometimes there's a 48-hour delay for account creation after your start date. Let me check. What's your employee ID?
I can confirm your record is active in the HRIS. The benefits sync runs at midnight. You should be able to enroll tomorrow morning. The 30-day window starts from your start date, not enrollment date.
Perfect, thanks! Which health plan do most people pick?

The PPO Gold plan is most popular — lower deductible and wider network. The HDHP with HSA is good if you're generally healthy. You can find plan comparison docs on the benefits portal under Documents.
My badge works for the main entrance but not for my department floor (5th floor).
Floor-specific access is provisioned separately. Your manager must submit a zone access request form through the facilities portal. I'll send you the link.
Is there a temporary solution? I have a meeting on the 5th floor in 30 minutes.
Go to the security desk in the main lobby. They can issue a temporary floor-access card valid for 24 hours. Bring your employee badge and ID.
Is there a standard email signature format I should use?

Yes — the template is on the internal wiki at wiki.internal.example.com/brand/email-signature. Standard format: Name, Title, Department, Company Name, Phone, Email. Optionally add LinkedIn and the company logo.
Thanks. Should I include my pronouns?
Pronouns are encouraged but optional. Add them in parentheses after your name: 'Riley Chen (they/them)'. The wiki has examples.
I bought a monitor for my home office. Can I get reimbursed? What's the limit?
Yes, the home office equipment stipend is $500 for new hires. File through Concur under 'Home Office Setup'. Attach the receipt. The policy is at policy.internal.example.com/hr/home-office.
The monitor was $650. Do I get $500 reimbursed or nothing because it's over?
You get reimbursed up to $500. The remaining $150 is out of pocket. Submit within 60 days of purchase. Expense reports are processed in the next pay cycle.
